content:
I would like to limit the maximum file length for submissions. There are performance trade-offs here, but I do not believe that extremely long files are necessary for performance.

I would like to add the maximum length in part to encourage more readable / human-auditable submissions, but also just to discourage "low effort" submissions (which sometimes then result in poor performance or excessive memory requirements, and this prematurely push me into providing bigger runners!)

I propose for now a 10,000 line limit per file. This will apply to upstream dependencies as well. (Mathlib has a 1,500 line limit, and Tau Ceti has a 3,000 line limit, so the upstream limits should not be too problematic for now.)
